THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:8066  CRL.P No. 102885 of 2023  ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the petition.

The contents of the memo are as under:
"The present petition is filed challenging the FIR since charge sheet is filed, the present petition would not survive for consideration.
Hence, the petitioner seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the present petition, with a liberty to file fresh challenging the charge sheet."
In view of the memo filed by the counsel for the petitioners, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.
